app.title: Campus Branch Parcels
app.description: Parcel operations for the campus branch.
brand.name: Campus Branch
notBuilt.text: This page is not built yet. Import Arrivals is ready to use now.
header.roleAdmin: Admin: can change settings and send a test SMS
login.tagline: Every parcel, from scan to message.
login.lead: The branch console for arrivals, customer phones and SMS notices.
login.internal: Internal use · reachable only on the branch network
login.dbNotReady: The branch database is not ready. Ask the office to run {command} and start the app again.
login.firstRunText: No account exists yet. On the office computer, run {command} in the project folder and type the code below. It works once.
login.private: Private to the branch. Sessions end after 7 days unused.
auth.error.badCode: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
auth.error.badRecovery: That username and recovery code do not match an active code.
auth.error.accountExists: An account already exists. Reload the page to sign in.
auth.error.invalidUsername: Username: 3 to 32 characters, letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
auth.error.databaseUnavailable: The branch database is not ready. Ask the office to start the app again.
auth.error.crossSite: This page must be opened from the branch address.
auth.error.passwordsDiffer: The two passwords do not match.
auth.error.paused: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
auth.error.generic: Could not sign in. Try again.
auth.error.offline: The branch computer did not answer. Check the connection and try again.
auth.passwordChanged: Password changed. Every device was signed out. Sign in with the new password.
auth.lead.reset: Use the recovery code from the office computer to set a new password.
auth.recover.where: On the office computer, in the project folder:
auth.recover.step1: 1. Create a code, if none exists yet or the last one was used:
auth.recover.step2: 2. Show it, then type it below. It works once.
journey.scanText: The parcel is scanned in at the branch.
journey.sortText: Grouped by arrival day and phone number.
journey.notifyText: One SMS tells the customer it is ready.
journey.svgTitle: A parcel is scanned, sorted, and the customer is notified by SMS
journey.caption: How Campus Branch handles a parcel
setup.step.installIphone: Get the {app} app from the App Store.
setup.step.installAndroid: Get the {app} app from Google Play.
setup.step.signIn: Sign in to the branch network
setup.step.signInText: Use the account the branch admin gave you. If the app says the device needs approval, ask the admin to approve it.
setup.step.turnOnIphone: In the Tailscale app, switch it on until it shows {connected}. It works on any Wi-Fi or mobile data.
setup.step.turnOnAndroid: Switch it on and allow the VPN connection Android asks about, until it shows {connected}.
setup.step.checkText: Return to this page and tap Check my phone.
setup.title: Set up this phone
setup.lead: Do this once per phone. Afterwards the phone opens the console securely and its camera can scan parcel barcodes.
setup.notSetUp: Not set up yet. Check that Tailscale shows Connected on this phone and that the admin approved it. The office computer must be on.
setup.noAddress: No secure address yet. The office needs to share the app with Tailscale Serve (Settings › Ready for phones? shows what is missing).
setup.stuck: Stuck? Ask the branch admin. Typing tracking codes works without this setup.
setup.readyText: Connected through the branch Tailscale network. The camera can now scan parcel barcodes. Allow the camera when the browser asks.
setup.tip: Tip: once it opens, add it to the Home Screen. iPhone: Share › Add to Home Screen. Android: the ⋮ menu › Add to Home screen.
